pages.title: Why Your Density Target Is Not a Design Brief - Article | Hektar
pages.meta_description: A density target tells you how much to build, not how to build it. On raw land, the gap between those two questions determines whether a project succeeds or fails. Treating density as an output of spatial decisions rather than an input produces better outcomes.
